name: Sustain
description: Catches what you play and holds it as an endless, even pad: play a chord and it hangs there, play the next and it glides over.

params.name: Mode
params.description: Auto catches every new note or chord and lets it replace what was held. Layer adds each new one on top of the old ones, so harmony piles up. Latch catches nothing until Hold is switched on.

params.name: Hold
params.description: In Auto and Layer, On keeps what is held for as long as it stays on and stops listening for new notes, so you can play over it. In Latch, On catches the sound of that moment and Off lets it go.

params.name: Sensitivity
params.description: How easily a new note is caught. Low needs a loud, clear attack; high also catches soft notes and gentle changes of harmony.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How slowly the held sound rises under the note you played. Short takes over almost at once; long swells in like bowed strings.

params.name: Decay
params.description: How long the held sound takes to die away once you stop playing, or in Latch once Hold is switched off. All the way up it never fades.

params.name: Glide
params.description: How long the old held sound takes to give way to a new one. Short changes chord at once; long lets one harmony melt into the next.

params.name: Motion
params.description: How much the held sound moves. At zero it is perfectly still, like an organ pipe; higher, every overtone drifts in pitch and level on its own, differently left and right.

params.name: Ensemble
params.description: Adds two slightly detuned copies of the held sound, one to each side, for the width and slow beating of a string section.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Colours the held sound. Left of centre takes the top off for a dark, round pad; right of centre leans it brighter and thinner.

params.name: Low Cut
params.description: Removes lows from the held sound so it does not cloud the bass of what you play over it.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between what you play and the held sound.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. An automatic sustain (freeze) effect in outline: onsets are found by spectral flux with a maximum filter (Boeck and Widmer, 'Maximum filter vibrato suppression for onset detection', 2013); after the attack the spectrum is cut at its peaks, each peak's frequency is taken from its phase advance (the phase vocoder of Flanagan and Golden, 1966) and its whole region is turned rigidly from then on (identity phase locking: Laroche and Dolson, 'Improved phase vocoder time-scale modification of audio', 1999); partials under 650 Hz are measured again from a frame four times as long and rebuilt as window lobes (Rodet and Depalle, 'Spectral envelopes and inverse FFT synthesis', 1992). Not a model or port of any product.
